design.split_policy: fresh seed/LHS/family; test zero is held out and never used for gate freeze

null_gate.source: zero-mismatch C+N raw-observable null population only

selective_calibration.purpose: false-activation/decorrelation floors only; positive mismatch quality is frozen separately from calibration+validation

production_cfar.definition: production GO-CFAR hit_cells / valid CUT cells, followed by production clustering
production_cfar.target_metric: target-on causal/legacy ROI detection from production detection CSV

score_map_pfa_diagnostic.definition: score-map all-cell diagnostic; production CFAR Pfa is the primary detector metric

postprocess.reason: correct actual activation semantics, explicit fallback opportunity cost, restrict final Pfa/Pd regression comparison to held-out test split, and include target preservation in final gate
